text: Clue isi video\nmein hai.\nDhyaan se dekhna!
10 baje MAA ne\nPriya ke kamre mein\nTORCH rakhi
"Torch rakhkar main\napne kamre mein\nchali gayi thi"
"Us torch ki battery\nraat bhar mein\nkhatam ho gayi hogi"
Ek aadmi ko wo\nBAAT pata thi...
...jo use pata ho\nhi NAHI sakti thi!
Shivam ki nazar se\nkoi nahi bachta.
